notes.title: Hello and current state of the game
notes.content:
G'Day folks! 

I just wanted to say hello and update you on the current status of "Alone in the Outback." We also want to let the community know that we are open to new ideas that align with the game's concept.

We are quite pleased with how the development is progressing so far. The game's functionality, systems, and basic loops are complete; our main goal now is to continue building the narrative, make stunning levels, and create an in-game survival guide. And, of course, optimise, optimise, optimise.

Another interesting fact about "Alone in the Outback" is that it is inspired by real stories and real locations in Northern Australia. In fact, a lot of the terrain is created using height maps from the real world, some of which you may well recognise. Please let us know if you are aware of any iconic outback spots that you believe everyone should know about :)
